digest.component_or_area: eval/calibration library surface for code-review project criteria
propositions: _code_review_prompt_id excludes activated project code-review criteria because it only admits static built-in physical ids and lacks repository context for logical-to-physical mapping
calibrate_criterion has no code-review membership branch and maps non-physical ids through the default plan-review namespace without repository awareness

When repo_root is provided, _code_review_prompt_id must admit both built-in physical ids and every logical id from code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root) mapped with criterion_prompt_id(logical_id, gate_key='code_review')

calibrate_criterion must select the code-review arm only when repo_root is not None and the criterion_id is active in code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root), otherwise retain existing plan-review behavior
Active project code-review criteria with missing eval specs must raise a located EvalError that includes the logical criterion_id and preserves the original path and message
